categories.main_business_segments: Clean Harbors operates two primary business segments: (1) Environmental Services, which provides hazardous and non-hazardous waste management, industrial cleaning, field and emergency response, and related services; and (2) Safety-Kleen Sustainability Solutions, which focuses on the collection, re-refining, and sale of used oil and related sustainable lubricant products, as well as automotive fluid recycling.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced waste treatment technologies including high-temperature incineration, landfill disposal, wastewater treatment, and solvent recovery. It operates nine hazardous waste incinerators, seven commercial landfills, ten wastewater treatment facilities, and seven oil re-refineries. Proprietary technologies, such as the Waste Information Network for waste tracking and specialized industrial cleaning tools, support operational efficiency and regulatory compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Clean Harbors serves a diversified customer base, including Fortune 500 companies, small businesses, and government entities. Key end markets include chemical, general manufacturing, oil and lubricants, refineries, automotive, government, utilities, transportation, retail, and construction. The company is also a major provider to the automotive service and industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across North America, with over 540 service locations in all 50 U.S. states, nine Canadian provinces, Puerto Rico, and Mexico. In 2021, 86% of revenues were generated in the United States and 14% in Canada, with assets and facilities distributed similarly.
categories.supply_chain_position: Clean Harbors operates primarily downstream in the environmental services supply chain, providing end-of-life waste management, recycling, and disposal services. In its Safety-Kleen Sustainability Solutions segment, it manages both upstream (collection of used oil) and downstream (re-refining and sale of lubricants) activities, creating a closed-loop system.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding cross-selling opportunities across business lines, investing in facility and technology upgrades, executing selective acquisitions (such as HydroChemPSC), and enhancing operational efficiency through automation and process improvements. The company emphasizes sustainability, safety, and regulatory compliance, with ongoing R&D in waste treatment, recycling, and lubricant formulation technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of service fees for waste collection, treatment, and disposal; product sales of re-refined base and blended oils, lubricants, and automotive fluids; and recurring service contracts for parts cleaning and maintenance. The company also earns revenue from large-scale remediation projects and emergency response services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Veolia North America, US Ecology, Harsco Corporation, Stericycle, Heritage-Crystal Clean, and various regional and local firms. Clean Harbors is positioned as the largest hazardous waste incinerator operator and used oil re-refiner in North America, with a broader service portfolio and geographic reach than any single competitor.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, Clean Harbors reported $3.8 billion in revenues, up 21% from 2020, with net income of $203 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $677 million. The company has demonstrated strong growth, both organically and through acquisitions, and maintains significant scale with over $5.6 billion in assets and approximately 19,100 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Clean Harbors differentiates itself through its comprehensive, integrated network of hazardous waste management and recycling facilities, proprietary technologies, and ability to offer a full suite of environmental and industrial services. Its closed-loop oil re-refining model, national footprint, strong safety record, and regulatory expertise provide unique value to customers seeking sustainable, compliant, and reliable solutions.
